name: 64085 · Richmond, MO
findings: ZIP 64085 (Richmond) has 53 nonprofit organizations. 19 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 64085 (Richmond) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
47% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 64085 (Richmond) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 62% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 64085 (Richmond) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 74% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 62% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
